title: Nice expirience!
text: Nice walk! very nice and relaxt guido from Venezuela, good englisch and nice tour. The wheater was cloudy and tue route to the top closed. So we walked through the forest!
author: tinus w

title: Snowshoeing in the Sierra Nevada!
text: What an adventure! An opportunity to snow shoe high in the Sierra Nevada, very experienced and helpful guide, a great experience!
author: Martina_P

title: Excellent guide
text: Great guide Harry. Skillful quiet man who enjoyed showing us the Sierra. Afterwards a picnic in a beautiful place. You were also picked up in Granada
author: carolienk639

title: A must do! experience in Sierra Nevada!!
text: Highly recommended! Unique and amazing experience.  Harry was the best!  Everything was well planned and coordinated.  Wait till you picnic looking at an unforgettable view.
author: 878hectord

title: Fantastic day trip from Granada .
text: Fantastic tour, Harry was a great guide, patient, knowledgeable and professional. fantastic views from the top. Lovely touch with lunch afterwards, home-made by Harry himself . Highly recommend this tour, if coming to Granada.
author: Simon_E

title: Great experience
text: Harry is very encouraging during the hike, and tried to motivate us to go forward. He explained what was to be expected in the next segment of the hike along the entire trek.
author: 822huisil

title: Excellent experience with Harry!
text: Excellent experience as always!! We had already done the Via Ferrata de Moclin and canyoning on the Green River, and we came back for more with Harry!! Excellent professional! We'll be back!!
author: LaNancha05

title: Wonderful experience in Sierra Nevada with snowshoes
text: All the moments are unique, the advice is to enjoy each one to the fullest! Harry sees to it that you pass ten.
author: Constanza A

title: Lovely snowy promenade
text: I can't choose a part because I like everything, the route, the trip, the conversation, the food prepared by themselves, and their professionalism. Thank you very much Harry for this wonderful day
author: Silvitorrez

title: Excellent
text:
I loved the experience. Harry the guide is a very knowledgeable person and is always watching that you are okay! He brings you a snack and water to eat when you go up and after you go down he has something to eat with a wine! 

I'll be doing other activities with Harry again. Excellent! I recommend this experience 100%.
author: Livinpulsw
